expected_facts.snapshot_features: product no-code_comments no-dwarf_stack_traces_mode x64 linux null-safety

generator_cmd: bash dart_gen.sh   # gcc -shared -nostdlib GNU-as .S exporting real _kDart* AOT snapshot dynsyms + snapshot.h header (magic 0xdcdcf5f5, kind 3, 32-hex version hash, features) + OneByteString-shaped HCFG; gcc C fake dartaotruntime (Dart_* API strings, version banner); dart2native append: pad 4096 + snapshot + u64 LE offset + dcdcf6f6 00000000; blob printf+gzip-trailer crc32, coreutils base64
oracle_cmd: bash dart_oracle.sh dart_standalone_b64.bin   # file -b, tail -c16|od (trailer), dd + readelf -W --dyn-syms/-S/-n, od/dd at the symbol file offset (snapshot header), strings -a (banner), grep -obUaP HCFG/SENGR + base64 -d
note: standalone ELF exporting the snapshot symbols itself, base64 (SENGR...) OneByteString, no compressed pointers, Dart 3.7.0 beta
